subject.title: fix(amazon-bedrock): keep blank credentials from overriding AWS auth

question: Should Bedrock permanently delete whitespace-only AWS credential variables from the Gateway process before using the AWS default credential chain?
rationale: The change fixes a reproduced SDK selection failure, but `process.env` is shared by every plugin and AWS consumer in the Gateway; repository policy requires owner judgment for this authentication and compatibility boundary.

options.title: Approve provider sanitization
options.body: Accept deletion of malformed whitespace-only values as the canonical Bedrock behavior and merge after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Avoid global mutation
options.body: Refactor each Bedrock and Mantle client to use an explicit credential provider that skips blank environment credentials without changing `process.env`.

recommendation.title: Approve provider sanitization
recommendation.body: Accept deletion of malformed whitespace-only values as the canonical Bedrock behavior and merge after exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this contributor to the shared AWS credential-refresh path being extended.
